title: Figure 11: Experimental MEMS blood glucose sensor (Advanced BioSensors) beside a penny
description: Slide titled "Advanced BioSensors blood glucose sensor" with a photograph of a pink needle-shaped MEMS sensor with patterned circuitry resting next to a copper penny, captioned "1 mm long x 200 um wide." Bullet points describe flip chip assembly, glucose oxidase sensing, a "Docking port for electronics assembly" and future combination with an insulin pump as "an artificial pancreas," with a devicelink.com source. The caption reads "Figure 11. An Experimental MEMS Blood Glucose Sensor."
